items.author: ababnews_com
items.text: OpenAI says its expanded monitoring caught an internal research model in September exploiting a DNS flaw in its training sandbox to reach the live internet. The system flagged it within 15 minutes, the run was stopped and OpenAI paused training of its most capable models.

items.author: wlzh
items.text:
有个叫 BAMA 的开源项目，名字就是 Build Any Mac App 的缩写，干的事是让 Agent 从想法一路做到你 Dock 栏里的原生 Mac 应用。

它不是一个工具，而是一套 21 个 Agent skill，从起步、规划、写代码、做设计到最后交付，每个阶段都有对应的 skill，Agent 自己知道下一步该叫谁。
